subject: Ecosys Summit — exhibit package scope, branding specs, and speaker slot
messages:
From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ecosyscon.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Events Team <events@ecosyscon.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ecosys Summit — exhibitor package + initial floorplan

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the interest in Ecosys Summit (Nov 18-20). Attached is the exhibitor package and the current floorplan (Ecosys_Exhibit_Floorplan_v3.pdf). The Silver+ package we discussed includes: a 10x20 island, double-sided demo table, two exhibitor badges, logo on the mobile app + website sponsor page, and a 25-minute breakout session (room A3).

A few notes up front:
- We can offer a stage LED banner (static logo) for $2k extra — ideally centered above the main stage (main hall).
- Lanyard branding is a separate add-on (minimum quantity and lead time apply).
- We’re holding a premium corner island (20x20) until EOD Friday for sponsors who want expanded footprint.

Can you confirm whether Redwood wants the 10x20 island as-is or would like to request the corner upgrade? Also need high-res logos and the W9/merchant info for invoicing.

Attachments: Ecosys_Exhibit_Floorplan_v3.pdf

Best,
Sara
Sara Mendoza
Sponsorship Manager, Ecosys Summit

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ecosyscon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosys Summit — exhibitor package + initial floorplan

Sara —

Appreciate the package and the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we commit:

1) Footprint: we’re leaning toward the 10x20 island to start, but we need clarification on demo table placement. For compute demos we require a corner adjacent to the main aisle to avoid traffic bottlenecks — is that feasible within the 10x20 allocation? If not, please confirm cost and availability to upgrade to the 20x20 corner.

2) Speaking slot: the Silver+ package shows a 25-minute breakout. We’d prefer a 30-minute technical deep-dive (with 10 minutes for Q&A). Can Ecosys extend the slot to 30 minutes or allow a 30/15 split if you keep the default schedule? We also want AV requirements confirmed: livestream capability and an HDMI feed for onstage demos.

3) Branding deliverables: request clearer specs — pixel/PPI for the LED banner, max file size for the app logo, and exact placement on the sponsor page (top-tier vs. supported). Also need deadlines for logo submission. We’ll upload Redwood_Logo_RGB.zip once we have the sizes confirmed.

4) Commercials: can you confirm if lead retrieval is included or an extra charge? Also need explicit cancellation and force-majeure language for our legal team. I’ve attached our high-level SOW redlines (we’ll send a formal doc if you prefer DocuSign).

If we can get the corner hold extended until Monday EOD while we internally confirm budget, that would help. Looping in Laura (Field Marketing) and Ben (Events Ops) to weigh in on logistics and AV.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: SOW_redlines.docx

From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ecosyscon.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Events Team <events@ecosyscon.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2025 14:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosys Summit — exhibitor package + initial floorplan

Connor —

Thanks — great questions. Quick answers inline: 

1) Footprint & demo placement: The 10x20 island can be positioned on the perimeter against an aisle (we can guarantee an aisle-facing demo table). Corner 20x20 is available for an incremental $6,500; we’ll unhold it for you through Monday EOD as requested.

2) Speaking slot: We can approve a 30-minute technical session (30/10 Q&A) provided the session is categorized as a technical case study. AV: basic livestream to the event portal + HDMI is included. If you need a multi-camera livestream package or RTMP ingest, that’s a $1,200 add-on.

3) Branding specs:
- LED banner: vector EPS or PDF, 300 dpi at final dimensions (we’ll send exact px once you confirm size).
- Mobile app logo: 512x512 PNG (max 2MB); sponsor page header: 1200x300 JPG (recommended).
- Sponsor page placement: Silver+ gets mid-tier placement; top-tier (hero) is reserved for Platinum. We can offer a top-line mention in the app newsfeed as a comp.
- Logo deadline: 10/20/2025 for all assets.

4) Lead retrieval: not included — $350 per device. Payment & legal: standard exhibitor T&Cs apply; we can accept your redlines but need legal to review force-majeure language (please send tracked changes).

I’ve attached an updated SOW with minor edits and the floorplan callouts. If you’re good with the 10x20 + 30-min slot and HDMI/livestream, I’ll prepare the invoice and DocuSign packet.

Attachments: Ecosys_Exhibit_Floorplan_v3.pdf (annotated)

Best,
Sara

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@ecosyscon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosys Summit — exhibitor package + initial floorplan

Sara —

Thanks for the fast clarification — that works for us. Summary and next steps: 

- We’ll take the 10x20 island with aisle-facing demo table and confirm final floorplan placement by 10/13. Please leave the 20x20 corner unheld after Monday (we won’t upgrade unless we close a run-rate sponsorship).
- Confirmed: 30-minute technical session (30/10 Q&A). We’ll submit the session abstract by 10/15 and confirm AV needs (HDMI + basic livestream) the same day. If we later need RTMP or extra cameras we’ll notify you by 11/1.
- Branding: we’ll upload Redwood_Logo_RGB.zip (including EPS and 512/1200 px versions) to your Drive link by 10/20.
- Lead retrieval: please add two devices to our invoice (we’ll pay $700).
- Legal: attaching our tracked redlines (SOW_redlines.docx) — please have legal confirm urgent items in the force-majeure clause. If everything looks good on your side, send the DocuSign and invoice and we’ll route for PO within two business days.

Cc’ing Rishi for procurement and Ben for booth build specs. Laura — can you confirm staffing plan and whether we want demo PC inventory on-site or ship racks?

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

—Connor
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
